commands.command: 'Get-Content -LiteralPath inputs/TASK.md; Get-ChildItem -Force; if (Test-Path .agents/skills) { Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File .agents/skills | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName }'
'Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File inputs; Get-Content -LiteralPath inputs/intake.json; Get-Command python,conda -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name,Source'

"python -c \"import zipfile,pathlib; from xml.etree import ElementTree as E; [(print('\\nFILE',p.name),[(print(n,z.read(n).decode('utf-8'))) for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('.xml')]) for p in pathlib.Path('inputs').glob('*.do*') for z in [zipfile.ZipFile(p)]]\""
